title: Setting New Standards with HARPS
what_was_studied: Architecture, first commissioning measurements and early stellar stability checks
numerical_result: The simultaneous ThAr test tracked drift at 0.1 m/s RMS; 420 alpha Cen B spectra had 0.51 m/s dispersion, with a 0.17 m/s single-measurement photon-noise estimate
remaining_question: The seven-hour stellar sequence and four-month nine-point check do not establish decades-long accuracy

title: A Frequency Comb calibrated Solar Atlas
what_was_studied: Prototype laser-comb lunar spectra used to compare frequency-comb and ThAr wavelength solutions
numerical_result: Order-scale S-shaped distortions reached approximately plus or minus 40 m/s in the stated comparison
remaining_question: Large local wavelength distortions do not translate directly into one stellar RV bias

title: HARPS Gets New Fibres After 12 Years of Operations
what_was_studied: Octagonal fibre installation, illumination tests, throughput and the resulting velocity discontinuity
numerical_result: Throughput increased by about 40% at 550 nm; a star-dependent offset was introduced across the fibre change
remaining_question: Pre- and post-upgrade data require separate zero points and the offset depends on spectral properties

title: A new wavelength calibration for echelle spectrographs using Fabry-Perot etalons
what_was_studied: Joint ThAr and Fabry-Perot wavelength solution for 15 years of HARPS calibration data
numerical_result: New solutions were built separately before and after the 2015 fibre change
remaining_question: Further gains require combining and validating ThAr Fabry-Perot and laser-comb information

title: Measuring and characterizing the line profile of HARPS with a laser frequency comb
what_was_studied: Two-dimensional comb-line measurements across the detector and as a function of line intensity
numerical_result: The target wavelength-scale precision discussed for Earth-twin work is 3 cm/s
remaining_question: That target motivates line-profile modelling but is not an achieved stellar time-series RMS

title: HARPS detector system upgrade and return to operations
what_was_studied: Detector, electronics, cooling and HAM fibre replacement followed by recommissioning
numerical_result: ESO records return to normal operations on 20 June 2026 and an ADC outage notice on 3 July 2026
remaining_question: A final post-upgrade performance report was not yet available on the checked page
